title: Total spent per customer via join
prompt: Return each customer's name along with their total amount spent (as total_spent). Customers with no orders can be excluded.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE c4 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO c4 VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'); CREATE TABLE o4 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO o4 VALUES (1,1,50.0),(2,1,30.0),(3,2,100.0),(4,3,10.0),(5,2,20.0);
reference_sql: SELECT c4.name, SUM(o4.amount) AS total_spent FROM c4 JOIN o4 ON c4.id = o4.customer_id GROUP BY c4.name;
